correctness.rationale: Irreducibility excludes fixed proper subspaces for each nontrivial C_p element; ranks prevent simplex inversions, so action is free. Solomon–Tits makes the cover simply connected for n>=4, with top sphere count 2^binom(n,2). Cartan–Leray gives H_i=C_p group homology for 0<i<n-2. Top homology is free and Euler division by p determines rank. The Serre spectral sequence injects classifying-map cohomology through degree d=n-2, which proves each Bockstein monomial. An odd prime n gives ord_p(2)=n for every p|2^n-1. The exact reproducibility checker verifies small dimensions n=4 and 5.

value.rationale: The hypothesis identifies a canonical primitive prime subgroup of the Singer symmetry acting freely on a finite spherical building. The theorem computes entire low-degree integral homology and nontrivial multiplicative torsion classes in an infinite family, including unbounded cup-length and exact free top rank. These are natural geometric invariants not captured by labeled building sphere-wedge counts or by the larger nonfree quotient; the result is more than an arbitrary numerical example.
